articles.title: U.S. government moves $288 million in seized bitcoin, ether to Coinbase Prime
articles.snippet: Coins from the Farace and BTC-e seizures moved through fresh wallets before landing on the exchange, despite president Donald Trump's previous no-sell reserve order.

articles.title: US government moves $297M in seized Bitcoin, Ether to Coinbase Prime
articles.snippet: The transfers have raised questions over Trump’s Bitcoin reserve pledge, though deposits to Coinbase Prime do not confirm an impending sale.

articles.title: US Government Moves $288M in Seized Crypto to Coinbase Prime
articles.snippet: The seized coins landed at the government's custodian, which stops short of a sale but has revived questions about Trump's no-sell pledge.

articles.title: Chinese Prosecutors Float Treating Crypto Mixer, Privacy Coin Use as Sign of Money Laundering
articles.snippet: An article in the top prosecutors' paper urges new blockchain evidence rules, presumptions of intent, and a state platform to sell seized coins.
